name: SynthECG
description: Abstract Background: Digitizing electrocardiogram (ECG) images into structured time-series data is critical for clinical analysis, but it remains challenging due to the lack of standardized datasets, especially under realistic scenarios like overlapping waveforms. Methods: We introduce SynthECG, an open-source Python framework to generate four synthetic ECG datasets tailored for deep learning tasks, including ECG digitization, YOLO-based lead and lead name detection, and U-Net-based waveform segmentation.
